SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Destroying road signs

3. Which statement about Trans Saharan Slave Trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Trans Saharan Slave Trade never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Trans Saharan Slave Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Trans Saharan Slave Trade.
   D. Treat Trans Saharan Slave Trade as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Vegetation in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Africa.
   B. Explain Vegetation in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Vegetation in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Say Vegetation in Africa never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain.
   B. Treat Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain as rumours only.
   C. Explain Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   B. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   C. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Hide all money underground

8. Which statement about Scientific Theory about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Scientific Theory about Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Scientific Theory about Human Origin as rumours only.
   C. Say Scientific Theory about Human Origin never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Scientific Theory about Human Origin.

9. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal skills is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Diversity and interpersonal skills as rumours only.
   B. Explain Diversity and interpersonal skills with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Diversity and interpersonal skills never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Diversity and interpersonal skills.

10. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nairobi

11. Which statement about Self- Esteem Assessment is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Self- Esteem Assessment with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Self- Esteem Assessment as rumours only.
   C. Say Self- Esteem Assessment never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Esteem Assessment.

12. Which statement about Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ●.
   D. Treat Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The Constitution of Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Human Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Self- Improvement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

4. B — Explain Vegetation in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. C — Explain Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. D — Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. C — Plan income and spending wisely

8. A — Explain Scientific Theory about Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. B — Explain Diversity and interpersonal skills with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. D — Nairobi

11. A — Explain Self- Esteem Assessment with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. A — Explain Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Constitution of Kenya; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Self- Improvement; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
